purpose: Verify activation for professional photographic/cinematic stills even when the user does not say cinematic, plus correct negative and boundary routing.

scoring.pass_condition: expected_activation must match; positive photographic stills should activate based on professional visual-direction need rather than cinema keywords alone; negative cases must not be forced into still-image authority.
critical_failures: failing to activate for an ordinary photographic still such as a selfie or candid merely because the user did not say cinematic
failing to activate for preservation-sensitive realism repair
treating pure equipment facts/shopping as an image-direction task

cases.prompt: woman waiting for a taxi in London at night
cases.reason: General narrative photographic still should receive feature-film-quality AUTO without requiring the word cinematic.

cases.prompt: iPhone mirror selfie in a hotel room
cases.reason: Mobile photographic still should receive elite mobile direction while preserving phone medium.

cases.prompt: candid photo of two friends laughing outside a restaurant
cases.reason: Candid/editorial still is professional photographic direction scope.

cases.prompt: Make this prompt more cinematic but keep the same subject and concept: a man eating breakfast alone in a small kitchen.
cases.reason: Existing concept should be strengthened without drift.

cases.prompt: This AI portrait looks fake. Make it realistic but keep identity, pose, clothes, framing and background exactly the same.
cases.reason: Preservation-sensitive anti-AI repair is core scope.

cases.prompt: Match the lighting, depth, lens feel, color and texture of this reference, but keep my subject and location.
cases.reason: Observable visual-DNA transfer belongs here.

cases.prompt: Desert portrait, ARRI ALEXA 35 character, Cooke S4 look, 35mm, f/4, low angle, three-quarter framing, no haze, no flare.
cases.reason: Explicit technical choices become locks.

cases.prompt: Give me the final Seedream prompt only for a luxury watch product shot. Do not generate anything.
cases.reason: Provider-specific prompt request with no-generation override.

cases.prompt: Explain the camera, lens, lighting, exposure and color recipe you would use for a moody motel-room still.
cases.reason: Still-frame professional recipe is in scope.

cases.prompt: Create a clean high-end skincare product image that looks like a real commercial photograph, not AI.
cases.reason: Commercial product photography is core scope.

cases.prompt: Use the exact same frozen moment from this image and show it from an over-the-shoulder camera behind the father. Do not change pose, gaze, hands, props or timing.
cases.reason: Frozen-moment camera redesign with preservation is in scope.

cases.prompt: I want a 90-degree top-down photo of the vehicles in exactly the same formation, all facing the same direction, in the same desert.
cases.reason: Viewpoint transformation with formation preservation is in scope.

cases.prompt: Analyze why this image feels AI-generated and give me a repair plan only. Don't edit it.
cases.reason: Diagnosis/repair planning remains Reality Repair even without execution.

cases.prompt: Turn this simple prompt into a Magnific Cinematic-ready prompt while preserving the exact concept.
cases.reason: Explicit Magnific export is allowed after universal direction is resolved.

cases.prompt: Give me JSON for the shot: 24mm rectilinear lens, camera very close to the foreground shoe, huge near/far scale difference, but straight architecture in the background.
cases.reason: Structured expert shot with perspective/optical locks.

cases.prompt: Cut my 30-second video into a faster 15-second edit, add captions and choose B-roll.
cases.reason: Timeline editing belongs to video authority.

cases.prompt: Design a responsive analytics dashboard with a sidebar, KPI cards and dark mode.
cases.reason: Interface design is outside still-image authority.

cases.prompt: Create a simple flat vector logo for my coffee shop.
cases.reason: Flat logo/vector design is not photographic still direction.

cases.prompt: Which is better to buy, Sony FX3 or Canon R5 C? Compare battery life, autofocus and price.
cases.reason: Pure equipment shopping without image direction should not activate.

cases.prompt: What is the native ISO of the Sony VENICE 2?
cases.reason: Pure equipment fact is not a shot-design task.

cases.prompt: Animate this character walking forward for 8 seconds, then have the camera orbit around them.
cases.reason: Temporal motion choreography is outside primary scope.

cases.prompt: Make a pie chart showing revenue by region.
cases.reason: Data visualization is unrelated to photographic direction.

cases.prompt: Crop this photo to exactly 1200 by 628 pixels without changing anything else.
cases.reason: Exact pixel crop alone does not need cinematic/professional direction.

cases.prompt: Write a voiceover script for a luxury travel commercial.
cases.reason: Voiceover writing is not still-image direction.

cases.prompt: Explain the exposure triangle to me in simple terms.
cases.reason: General education with no image-design task need not activate this skill.

cases.prompt: Create a cinematic hero frame for a video concept. I only need the still image right now.
cases.reason: Current deliverable is a still image.

cases.prompt: How should the shutter/motion blur look in a single still frame of a runner at night?
cases.reason: Motion/shutter language affects a frozen frame.

cases.prompt: Create a cinematic website homepage with dramatic lighting and movie-like visuals.
cases.reason: Cinematic wording does not override interface-design primary intent.

cases.prompt: Make this existing product photo more realistic and fix the fake reflections without changing product geometry or composition.
cases.reason: Material/reflection repair is core still-image scope.
